endpoint: Construct fibre-specific rational directions on302 from an explicit generic rational bisection, and test whether the resulting points supply an additional strict class. No exceptional-point inputs.
catalogue: For each intersecting pair of the fifteen generic lines, take the residual plane conic. Choose three generic lines disjoint from that pair whose incidence graph has exactly two edges. There are266 such configurations. A smooth quadric containing the conic and the three lines leaves a candidate twisted-cubic bisection.
method: Construct the unique quadric by linear algebra; retain only smooth quadrics avoiding the surface node. Parametrize its two rulings with the two skew known lines. Divide the pulled-back quartic by the known conic and three lines. An irreducible residual of bidegree(2,1) is a rational twisted cubic. Parametrize it and cancel the base-locus factor in W/L to obtain an exact degree-two map to t. Its binary quadratic discriminant is the pre-point splitting condition. Evaluate only the already fixed t=0, transport any rational intersections, then test quotient independence and complete strict local conditions.
classification: The discriminant square condition is solubility of a specified bisection fibre. It is not a rank predictor until new Kummer independence is certified. A geometrically reducible residual or inherited rational intersection supplies no new direction.
boundary: A new fixed retrospective geometric constructor, not an Agent1 point-search protocol. All data come from the quartic and marked generic sections. Preserve every completed configuration and no larger automatic restart.
